summary.text: Mike Bayham is a Republican member of the Louisiana House of Representatives, representing District 103 (St. Bernard Parish), and was elected in 2023, according to the official House member page.

paragraphs.text: The member page lists Mike Bayham's occupation as Communications/Marketing.
It lists education as B.A., Louisiana State University.

The page lists committee assignments including Agriculture, Forestry, Aquaculture, and Rural Development, Commerce, and Insurance, and caucus affiliations including the Louisiana Republican Legislative Delegation and the Louisiana Rural Caucus.
